Blank lines are ignored; malformed lines are\n// skipped with a diagnostic on the warning writer.\npackage logread\n\nimport (\n\t\"bufio\"\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n)\n\n// Record is one execution from the log, normalized for reporting.\ntype Record struct {\n\tExecutionID    string\n\tStartedAt      string\n\tDate           string\n\tStatus         string\n\tFailed         bool\n\tCommand        string\n\tTarget         string\n\tProvider       string\n\tRequestedModel string\n\tModel          string\n\tInputTokens    int64\n\tCachedTokens   int64\n\tOutputTokens   int64\n\tCostUSD        float64\n\tElapsedMS      int64\n\tReturnCode     *int\n\tTimedOut       bool\n}\n\n// Result is what Read produced from a log: the decoded records and the number of skipped lines.\ntype Result struct {\n\tRecords []Record\n\tSkipped int\n}\n\n// wireLine mirrors one JSON Lines object. Absent fields decode to their zero value.\ntype wireLine struct {\n\tExecutionID string `json:\"execution_id\"`\n\tStartedAt   string `json:\"started_at\"`\n\tStatus      string `json:\"status\"`\n\tJob         struct {\n\t\tCommandName string `json:\"command_name\"`\n\t\tTarget      string `json:\"target\"`\n\t\tLLM         string `json:\"llm\"`\n\t\tModel       string `json:\"model\"`\n\t} `json:\"job\"`\n\tResult struct {\n\t\tReturnCode *int `json:\"returncode\"`\n\t\tTimedOut   bool `json:\"timed_out\"`\n\t\tStats      struct {\n\t\t\tCachedInputTokens int64   `json:\"cached_input_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tElapsedMS         int64   `json:\"elapsed_ms\"`\n\t\t\tInputTokens       int64   `json:\"input_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tOutputTokens      int64   `json:\"output_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tCostUSD           float64 `json:\"cost_usd\"`\n\t\t\tModel             string  `json:\"model\"`\n\t\t} `json:\"stats\"`\n\t} `json:\"result\"`\n}\n\n// Read decodes every non-blank line of r as one log record. Malformed lines are counted in\n// Result.Skipped and described on warn. The error is non-nil only when reading from r fails.\nfunc Read(r io.Reader, warn io.Writer) (Result, error) {\n\tif warn == nil {\n\t\twarn = io.Discard\n\t}\n\tvar res Result\n\tbr := bufio.NewReader(r)\n\tfor lineNo := 1; ; lineNo++ {\n\t\tline, err := br.ReadBytes('\\n')\n\t\tif trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(line); len(trimmed) > 0 {\n\t\t\trec, perr := parseLine(trimmed)\n\t\t\tif perr != nil {\n\t\t\t\tres.Skipped++\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(warn, \"line %d: skipped: %v\\n\", lineNo, perr)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tres.Records = append(res.Records, rec)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {\n\t\t\treturn res, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn res, err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// parseLine decodes one non-blank, whitespace-trimmed line into a Record.\nfunc parseLine(data []byte) (Record, error) {\n\tif data[0] != '{' {\n\t\treturn Record{}, errors.New(\"not a JSON object\")\n\t}\n\tvar w wireLine\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &w); err != nil {\n\t\treturn Record{}, err\n\t}\n\treturn Record{\n\t\tExecutionID:    w.ExecutionID,\n\t\tStartedAt:      w.StartedAt,\n\t\tDate:           firstRunes(w.StartedAt, 10),\n\t\tStatus:         w.Status,\n\t\tFailed:         w.Status != \"succeeded\",\n\t\tCommand:        w.Job.CommandName,\n\t\tTarget:         w.Job.Target,\n\t\tProvider:       w.Job.LLM,\n\t\tRequestedModel: w.Job.Model,\n\t\tModel:          w.Result.Stats.Model,\n\t\tInputTokens:    w.Result.Stats.InputTokens,\n\t\tCachedTokens:   w.Result.Stats.CachedInputTokens,\n\t\tOutputTokens:   w.Result.Stats.OutputTokens,\n\t\tCostUSD:        w.Result.Stats.CostUSD,\n\t\tElapsedMS:      w.Result.Stats.ElapsedMS,\n\t\tReturnCode:     w.Result.ReturnCode,\n\t\tTimedOut:       w.Result.TimedOut,\n\t}, nil\n}\n\n// firstRunes returns the first n characters of s, or all of s when it is shorter.\nfunc firstRunes(s string, n int) string {\n\tr := []rune(s)\n\tif len(r) > n {\n\t\tr = r[:n]\n\t}\n\treturn string(r)\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1742,"cache_read_input_tokens":29579,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1742},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"382383c0-ed81-4bef-8936-b1a1ccbd38f1","uuid":"0694bc89-ddda-4bf0-b7a2-44c2e9616fa9","timestamp":"2026-10-26T15:35:42.468Z","request_id":"req_011CgR6Q5azNYN4mu76fB5fM","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01CUwr7i1eBFQpxKfk5NGh4V":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.152123/build/DrydockStats/internal/logread/logread.go","content":"// Package logread reads Drydock's JSON Lines LLM execution log into Records.\n//\n// It never writes to the log it reads. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01CUwr7i1eBFQpxKfk5NGh4V","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.152123/build/DrydockStats/internal/logread/logread.go (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"382383c0-ed81-4bef-8936-b1a1ccbd38f1","uuid":"05aef7cc-92d0-41c7-b5db-6acf350c10ce","timestamp":"2026-10-26T15:35:42.557Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.152123/build/DrydockStats/internal/logread/logread.go","content":"// Package logread reads Drydock's JSON Lines LLM execution log into Records.\n//\n// It never writes to the log it reads. Blank lines are ignored; malformed lines are\n// skipped with a diagnostic on the warning writer.\npackage logread\n\nimport (\n\t\"bufio\"\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n)\n\n// Record is one execution from the log, normalized for reporting.\ntype Record struct {\n\tExecutionID    string\n\tStartedAt      string\n\tDate           string\n\tStatus         string\n\tFailed         bool\n\tCommand        string\n\tTarget         string\n\tProvider       string\n\tRequestedModel string\n\tModel          string\n\tInputTokens    int64\n\tCachedTokens   int64\n\tOutputTokens   int64\n\tCostUSD        float64\n\tElapsedMS      int64\n\tReturnCode     *int\n\tTimedOut       bool\n}\n\n// Result is what Read produced from a log: the decoded records and the number of skipped lines.\ntype Result struct {\n\tRecords []Record\n\tSkipped int\n}\n\n// wireLine mirrors one JSON Lines object. Absent fields decode to their zero value.\ntype wireLine struct {\n\tExecutionID string `json:\"execution_id\"`\n\tStartedAt   string `json:\"started_at\"`\n\tStatus      string `json:\"status\"`\n\tJob         struct {\n\t\tCommandName string `json:\"command_name\"`\n\t\tTarget      string `json:\"target\"`\n\t\tLLM         string `json:\"llm\"`\n\t\tModel       string `json:\"model\"`\n\t} `json:\"job\"`\n\tResult struct {\n\t\tReturnCode *int `json:\"returncode\"`\n\t\tTimedOut   bool `json:\"timed_out\"`\n\t\tStats      struct {\n\t\t\tCachedInputTokens int64   `json:\"cached_input_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tElapsedMS         int64   `json:\"elapsed_ms\"`\n\t\t\tInputTokens       int64   `json:\"input_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tOutputTokens      int64   `json:\"output_tokens\"`\n\t\t\tCostUSD           float64 `json:\"cost_usd\"`\n\t\t\tModel             string  `json:\"model\"`\n\t\t} `json:\"stats\"`\n\t} `json:\"result\"`\n}\n\n// Read decodes every non-blank line of r as one log record. Malformed lines are counted in\n// Result.Skipped and described on warn. The error is non-nil only when reading from r fails.\nfunc Read(r io.Reader, warn io.Writer) (Result, error) {\n\tif warn == nil {\n\t\twarn = io.Discard\n\t}\n\tvar res Result\n\tbr := bufio.NewReader(r)\n\tfor lineNo := 1; ; lineNo++ {\n\t\tline, err := br.ReadBytes('\\n')\n\t\tif trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(line); len(trimmed) > 0 {\n\t\t\trec, perr := parseLine(trimmed)\n\t\t\tif perr != nil {\n\t\t\t\tres.Skipped++\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(warn, \"line %d: skipped: %v\\n\", lineNo, perr)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tres.Records = append(res.Records, rec)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {\n\t\t\treturn res, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn res, err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// parseLine decodes one non-blank, whitespace-trimmed line into a Record.\nfunc parseLine(data []byte) (Record, error) {\n\tif data[0] != '{' {\n\t\treturn Record{}, errors.New(\"not a JSON object\")\n\t}\n\tvar w wireLine\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &w); err != nil {\n\t\treturn Record{}, err\n\t}\n\treturn Record{\n\t\tExecutionID:    w.ExecutionID,\n\t\tStartedAt:      w.StartedAt,\n\t\tDate:           firstRunes(w.StartedAt, 10),\n\t\tStatus:         w.Status,\n\t\tFailed:         w.Status != \"succeeded\",\n\t\tCommand:        w.Job.CommandName,\n\t\tTarget:         w.Job.Target,\n\t\tProvider:       w.Job.LLM,\n\t\tRequestedModel: w.Job.Model,\n\t\tModel:          w.Result.Stats.Model,\n\t\tInputTokens:    w.Result.Stats.InputTokens,\n\t\tCachedTokens:   w.Result.Stats.CachedInputTokens,\n\t\tOutputTokens:   w.Result.Stats.OutputTokens,\n\t\tCostUSD:        w.Result.Stats.CostUSD,\n\t\tElapsedMS:      w.Result.Stats.ElapsedMS,\n\t\tReturnCode:     w.Result.ReturnCode,\n\t\tTimedOut:       w.Result.TimedOut,\n\t}, nil\n}\n\n// firstRunes returns the first n characters of s, or all of s when it is shorter.\nfunc firstRunes(s string, n int) string {\n\tr := []rune(s)\n\tif len(r) > n {\n\t\tr = r[:n]\n\t}\n\treturn string(r)\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01CUwr7i1eBFQpxKfk5NGh4V","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgR6TMazoVfWaugZHkpw9","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01VEMDWwxD2UBFGZVWrYEeuU","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DrydockStats/runs/20261026.152123/build/DrydockStats/internal/logread/logread_test.go","content":"package logread_test\n\nimport (\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"ddkstat/internal/logread\"\n)\n\n// entry builds one JSON Lines object with the fields Read consumes.\nfunc entry(id, status, startedAt string) string {\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(`{\"schema_version\":1,\"execution_id\":%q,\"started_at\":%q,\"status\":%q,`+\n\t\t`\"job\":{\"command_name\":\"build\",\"target\":\"Toml\",\"llm\":\"claude\",\"model\":\"haiku\"},`+\n\t\t`\"result\":{\"returncode\":0,\"timed_out\":false,\"stats\":{\"input_tokens\":10,\"cached_input_tokens\":20,`+\n\t\t`\"output_tokens\":30,\"cost_usd\":0.5,\"elapsed_ms\":40,\"model\":\"claude-haiku-5-5\"}}}`,\n\t\tid, startedAt, status)\n}\n\nfunc read(t *testing.T, input string) logread.Result {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tres, err := logread.Read(strings.NewReader(input), &bytes.Buffer{})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Read: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn res\n}\n\nfunc TestReadBlankLines(t *testing.T) {\n\tinput := \"\\n\" +\n\t\t\"   \\n\" +\n\t\tentry(\"a\", \"succeeded\", \"2026-10-14T06:37:54.176Z\") + \"\\n\" +\n\t\t\"\\t\\n\" +\n\t\t\"\\n\" +\n\t\tentry(\"b\", \"succeeded\", \"2026-10-15T06:37:54.176Z\") + \"\\n\" +\n\t\t\"\\n\"\n\tres := read(t, input)\n\tif len(res.Records) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"records = %d, want 2\", len(res.Records))\n\t}\n\tif res.Records[0].ExecutionID != \"a\" || res.Records[1].ExecutionID != \"b\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"ids = %q, %q; want a, b\", res.Records[0].ExecutionID, res.Records[1].ExecutionID)\n\t}\n\tif res.Skipped != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"skipped = %d, want 0 (blank lines are not skips)\", res.Skipped)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadBlankOnlyInput(t *testing.T) {\n\tres := read(t, \"\\n\\n   \\n\")\n\tif len(res.Records) != 0 || res.Skipped != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"got %d records, %d skipped; want 0, 0\", len(res.Records), got != \"one.jsonl\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"LogPath = %q, want one.jsonl\", got)\n\t}\n\texpectUsageError(t, \"summary\")\n\texpectUsageError(t, \"summary\", \"one.jsonl\", \"two.jsonl\")\n\texpectUsageError(t, \"summary\", \"one.jsonl\", \"two.jsonl\", \"three.jsonl\")\n}\n\nfunc TestParseOptionAfterLogPathIsUsageError(t *testing.T) {","originalFile":"package cli_test\n\nimport (\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"ddkstat/internal/cli\"\n)\n\nfunc mustParse(t *testing.T, args ...string) cli.Options {\n\tt.Helper()\n\topts, err := cli.ParseArgs(args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ParseArgs(%q): %v\", args, err)\n\t}\n\treturn opts\n}\n\nfunc expectUsageError(t *testing.T, args ...string) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\t_, err := cli.ParseArgs(args)\n\tvar usage *cli.UsageError\n\tif !errors.As(err, &usage) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"ParseArgs(%q) error = %v, want *UsageError\", args, err)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseReportAndLog(t *testing.T) {\n\tgot := mustParse(t, \"summary\", \"log.jsonl\")\n\twant := cli.Options{Report: \"summary\", LogPath: \"log.jsonl\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"Options = %+v, want %+v\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseEveryKnownReport(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, report := range []string{\"summary\", \"commands\", \"targets\", \"models\", \"daily\", \"failures\"} {\n\t\tif got := mustParse(t, report, \"log.jsonl\").Report; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgR6WEZerpXwA9h2KTnWY","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Both stories and the test script are done. `sh bin/test.sh` exits 0, and all 35 Go tests pass.\n\n- **log-lines:** `logread.Read` parses the sample log into 35 records, with 1 skipped (line 16, truncated JSON) and 2 failed.
